dialogue: A particular email catches my eye in particular...
"new initiative for the company starting soon; looking for those interested in this next step."
"Dear esteemed managers of the Atman Corporation,
We're coming up on Atman's 50th anniversary this year, and with big birthdays like that come big changes to our family!
Don't worry - we aren't gonna fire any of you wonderful managers, but we are asking you to make a big decision.
We as a company are hoping that we can raise our productivity and production to create more goods for the people who need them the most.
Our team at Atman's headquarters has been devising a plan for more than a decade to make this possible...
And we've set everything in place, now we just need you all to implement it properly.
We've been testing a new [[SHAKE]]hybrid computer-human intelligence[[ENDSHAKE]] at select controlled facilities.
It's shown a 500% increase in worker productivity and efficiency, beating out leading competitors in our field by a wide margin.
With your lovely managers helping to integrate this technology into our workplace, you'll change the landscape of not only our company...
Though keep in mind that this'll be a large undertaking, that some of you may not be prepared for.
Though, I suggest if you want to keep being an important part of this company, you will participate.
For more details, please contact me or another administrative official over Direct Correspondence..
As E-Mail is not secure enough for information like this.
Jane Atman                                                     VP of Operations at Atman."
